# How to Use Software WAGO I/O CHECK 3 to Operate and Display a WAGO I/O System 750 Node
 
Software WAGO I/O CHECK 3 is a Windows application that allows you to operate and display a WAGO I/O System 750 node without connecting to a fieldbus system. It is a useful tool for checking the field wiring, including all sensors and actuators, before startup. It also enables you to make application-specific settings for some types of interface, Pt100 and thermocouple modules. In this article, we will show you how to use Software WAGO I/O CHECK 3 to communicate with a WAGO I/O System 750 node and perform various tasks.

## Requirements
 
To use Software WAGO I/O CHECK 3, you will need the following:
 
- A PC with Windows operating system
- Software WAGO I/O CHECK 3 installed on your PC (you can download it from [here](https://www.wago.com/global/software/wago-i-o-check/p/759-302_000-923))
- A WAGO I/O System 750 node with a coupler and one or more I/O modules
- A communication cable (USB or serial) to connect the coupler to your PC

## Steps
 
Follow these steps to use Software WAGO I/O CHECK 3:

1. Connect the communication cable between the coupler and your PC.
2. Launch Software WAGO I/O CHECK 3 on your PC.
3. Select the communication port and the baud rate from the drop-down menus.
4. Click on "Connect" to establish communication with the node.
5. The software will read the configuration from the node and display it graphically on the screen. You can also see the node address, firmware version, serial number and hardware version of the coupler.
6. To display and specify the process data of the I/O modules, click on "Process Data". You can see the input and output values of each module in hexadecimal or decimal format. You can also change the output values by clicking on them and entering new values.
7. To make application-specific settings for some types of interface, Pt100 and thermocouple modules, click on "Settings". You can see the current settings of each module and change them according to your needs. For example, you can change the sensor type, measurement range, filter time or linearization mode.
8. To print or save the configuration as documentation, click on "File" and select "Print" or "Save As". You can choose to print or save the graphic view, the list view or both.
9. To disconnect from the node, click on "Disconnect".
